newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet prices rally with NYMEX, diffs steady.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet prices rally with NYMEX, diffs steady.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices jumped higher Wednesday tracking the NYMEX rally, though little movement seen in differentials.
Very few barrels changed hands during the day, which saw the NYMEX heating oil shed more than 1 cent during the first half before rallying to settle up 2 cents on the day.
U.S. Gulf 54-grade jet fuel for prompt delivery was talked near 3.00 cents unmder the screen, near steady with levels reported on Tuesday, according to traders.
Prompt 55-grade barrels were talked at about 2.00 cents under the print, also steady with previous prices.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626
